en.headline: deTour design festival opens Friday at PMQ with free entry through November 29
en.dek: PMQ hosts the annual design event under the theme Better, Not Perfect, featuring 14 works by local and international creators plus a pop-up shop.
body: The deTour 2026 design festival opens to the public on Friday at PMQ in Central and runs through 29 November. Admission is free. Opening hours are 11:00 to 15:00 on the first day and 11:00 to 20:00 thereafter, according to the organisers.

This year’s theme is Better, Not Perfect: Prototypes for Tomorrow, with Shin Wong as curator-at-large. The programme brings together 14 works by creators from Hong Kong, the Chinese mainland and overseas, displayed across three zones in the courtyard and marketplace. A pop-up shop will sell limited-edition designer items and festival merchandise for the first time.

The event is organised by PMQ and supported by the Cultural and Creative Industries Development Agency. Workshops, design dialogues and guided tours are also scheduled, with some requiring advance registration. Details are available from the organisers.

zh.headline: deTour設計節周五於元創方開幕 免費入場至11月29日
zh.dek: PMQ元創方主辦年度設計盛事，主題「不完美，更美好」，展出14件本地及海外作品，並設快閃選物店。
body: deTour 2026設計節將於周五向公眾開放，地點在中環PMQ元創方，展期至11月29日。入場免費。主辦單位指，首日開放時間為上午11時至下午3時，其後為上午11時至晚上8時。
今屆主題為「BETTER, NOT PERFECT 不完美，更美好：Prototypes for Tomorrow」，總策展人為黃馨。展覽匯聚14件來自香港、內地及海外創作者的作品，分三大展區於中庭及市集展出。場內首次設快閃選物店，售賣設計師限量產品及周邊。
活動由PMQ元創方主辦，文創產業發展處資助。期間另設工作坊、設計對話及導賞團，部分需預先登記。詳情可向主辦單位查詢。
